text:
Cal: thinking out loud — can we add a hold/until flag to the deploy bot so releases automatically stay paused until the change window opens? would reduce manual wait-and-click in the console.

Jess: nice. i keep forgetting to hold the big infra rollouts until the 02:00 UTC window. how would that look from CLI/ops side?

Cal: proposal sketch: `/deploy start --ref=release-2026-03 --pin=rev-abc123 --hold-until=2026-03-22T02:00Z` — bot will reserve resources and post a pinned message in the channel when it actually starts.

Samir: if bot reserves resources, we should surface a soft timeout and a cancel command. e.g. `--hold-timeout=3h` so we don't consume capacity forever. also need a policy for priority queues (safest: fallback to lower-cost region).

Maria: can we surface expected ETA and a small checklist in the announcement so oncall knows what to watch for? example payload the bot posts:``` 
Starting release: release-2026-03
Pinned rev: rev-abc123
Scheduled start: 2026-03-22T02:00Z UTC
ETA to steady-state: ~8m
Canary: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> 100%
Actions: monitor latency, error-rate, logs
Containment: rollback command ready
```

Jess: love that. also +1 for a quick rollback verb like `/deploy rollback --to=rev-abc123 --reason="regression detected" --fast` that flips traffic and tears down canaries. we should ensure `--fast` requires two approvers or an override from ops-bot.

deploy-bot: [automated] note: new flags acknowledged: `--hold-until`, `--hold-timeout`, `--fast`. Approval policy: `--fast` requires 2 approvers by default unless `--ops-override` is supplied.

Cal: for release notes, can we auto-generate a short blurb by pulling changelog entries from PR labels? a template: `changelog: {{pr:summary}} (authors: {{pr:authors}})` and bot attaches it to the message. quick example:``` 
/bin/release-notes-gen --since=tag/v2026-02 --format=short > release-notes.md
```

Samir: edge case: what if hold-until passes but capacity is short? bot should run a retry window and then either queue or fallback to a compatible model/region. include `--fallback=region:eu-west-1` or `--fallback=model:small-quant` options.

Maria: ops runbook addition: if `--hold-until` is used, oncall should: 1) confirm scheduled start, 2) check capacity dashboard 15m prior, 3) watch canary metrics for first 15m, 4) be ready to run ` /deploy rollback --to=<prev> --fast --ops-override` if regression spikes.

Jess: can we add a tiny helper to annotate deploys with a concise rollout note? e.g. `/deploy annotate "sensitivity: search-index"` so later queries in console show that metadata.

Cal: yes. metadata flags: `--annotate key=val` multiple times. bot posts structured badge in channel.

ops-bot: [automated] suggestion: add a `deploy-template` subcommand to create a change-window friendly JSON with fields: ref, pin, hold-until, ETA, canary-plan. sample:``` 
/deploy template create --name="infra-weekly" --json > infra-weekly.json
```

Samir: ok next steps: 1) sketch CLI flags + validation rules, 2) wire bot to reserve capacity + TTL, 3) add approval guard for `--fast`, 4) draft runbook and template examples. i'll PR a WIP RFC today.

Jess: perfect — if you drop the RFC link here i can prototype the release-notes-gen script and the annotate UI. :thumbsup:

Cal: RFC: https://rfc.internal/release-bot/hold-until (WIP) — thanks everyone, will iterate on the timeout semantics and fallback behavior.
